components.name: Autonomous Factor Research Campaign Orchestrator v1
components.responsibility: Freeze and execute bounded multi-round Agent factor research through static Admission, cheap screening, default-first evaluation, local rescue, annual evidence, failure memory, automatic planning, Candidate locking, checkpoint recovery and exact replay.
current_limitations: Single-process, single-host runtime; scheduling and distributed workers are outside v1.
Candidate Locks remain research_registered and all report-period evidence is retrospective and contaminated.
The first formal Campaign generated three eligible Candidates, not the five-Candidate capacity maximum.

components.name: Breadth-Gated Momentum Overlay and Fresh Forward Protocol v1
components.responsibility: Bind immutable Signal D to the formal lagged Fixed-100 breadth regime, publish fixed U/G/R retrospective diagnostics, pre-register a no-backfill Fresh lock, increment Tushare data and evaluate minimum-gated forward evidence.
current_limitations: Fresh evidence has only 20 completed return sessions and remains accumulating below the frozen 60/5/20/3 gate.
Historical U/G/R execution is a bounded CnExchange-cost mechanism diagnostic and does not replace a formal Qlib conclusion.
Runtime is single-process and incremental collection is manually invoked rather than scheduled.

components.name: Momentum Tail-Alpha and Selection-Overlay Diagnostic v1
components.responsibility: Diagnose immutable Signal D through formal-label RankIC, adjusted-close deciles and tail metrics, fixed gross Top-N baskets, 2023 attribution, beta/style/breadth exposure, stability, rank transition and decay, then publish governed Store artifacts.
current_limitations: Retrospective diagnostic only; not Fresh Validation, Frozen Test, Candidate selection, Promotion or production evidence.
Top-N returns are gross-only because formal trading costs are unavailable on this diagnostic path.
Historical PIT industry attribution is omitted because no governed industry contract exists; beta/style decomposition is diagnostic rather than causal.

components.name: Low-Frequency Momentum and Turnover-Control Study v1
components.responsibility: Pre-register four fixed Momentum signals and B0/L1 execution protocols, run complete annual/full-period formal Qlib evidence, apply frozen eligibility, and publish immutable Store-backed diagnostics with cold recovery and exact replay.
current_limitations: Evidence is retrospective, not Fresh Validation, Frozen Test, Promotion or production evidence.
No signal passed all frozen eligibility gates, so Candidate Locks and later-period reports are absent by design.
Formal Qlib positions are available but its isolated Redis-disabled trade list is empty; holding transitions use positions and cost/turnover use the CnExchange collector.

components.name: Replayable Skip-Recent Momentum Research v1
components.responsibility: Persist complete Agent-to-candidate evidence and run bounded six-subfamily skip-recent research with four-Fold locks and formal Qlib evaluation.
current_limitations: Retrospective research only; not Fresh Validation, Frozen Test, Promotion or production evidence.
Both locks and the ensemble underperform CSI300 in 2025 and 2026H1.
Single-host runtime serializes Qlib feature loading for legacy pkg_resources compatibility.

components.name: Existing LightGBM Training
components.responsibility: Build LightGBM training configuration, run containerized training, and emit model artifacts.
current_limitations: Model metadata does not lock QuantMind 2.0 Factor Instance and Materialization identities.
Declared label_formula does not control the actual label implementation.

components.name: Existing Model Inference
components.responsibility: Load registered models and produce predictions from prepared features.
current_limitations: Unified Signal Artifact integration is not implemented.

components.name: Existing Qlib Backtest
components.responsibility: Execute official Qlib strategies, exchange simulation, portfolio backtest, and persistence.
current_limitations: Dataset Snapshot and Unified Signal lineage are not yet first-class inputs.

components.name: Existing Risk Analysis
components.responsibility: Analyze official Qlib portfolio and trade results.
current_limitations: QuantMind 2.0 Experiment lineage is not recorded.

components.name: Feature Snapshots
components.responsibility: Historical annual-Parquet compatibility code; its data authority and local data were retired and purged by QM2-P0-014.
current_limitations: Formal runtime use is forbidden; code remains only for historical compatibility and must not recreate authority.

components.name: Official V7 Factor Lab Source
components.responsibility: Read-only donor for Agent, Candidate, Docker sandbox, validation, campaign, and Research Memory capabilities.
current_limitations: Python-first candidate contract.
Agent selects structure and concrete parameters together.
No formal ResearchDecision or Decision Validator boundary.
Campaign and research drivers combine decision, loop-control, dispatch, and feedback roles.
JSON registry is replaceable.
Source resides under /tmp.
No target Factor Optimization or Frozen Test isolation.

components.name: Project Knowledge
components.responsibility: Provide repository context, ADRs, implementation contracts, validation, and later API/web indexes.
current_limitations: Domain, ORM, mappers, migration 0001, async PostgreSQL Repository/UoW, self-reference-free Manifest v2 producer, strict new-v2 validation, bounded committed-v2 compatibility, trusted binding, Git consistency, Indexer, and CLI exist; API and web UI do not.
QM2-P0-006 remains Git-inconsistent because of one immutable before_hash transcription error; QM2-P0-006F records separate correction evidence without changing the old Run.
No production database has been migrated and final execution-role/schema privilege policy is not frozen.
Manifest v1 cannot construct complete Domain Bundles for historical Runs; v2 resolves future evidence production only.
At B1 base 0353435, 16 of 17 historical v1 Runs pass Git evidence but 0 of 17 are indexable; QM2-P0-001F also fails result-commit consistency.
Manifest v2 validates explicit artifact location kind before constructing the unchanged Domain object.
Read-only Unit of Work optimization is deferred and Relationship admission uses a conservative whole-graph advisory lock.
Pinned SQLAlchemy 2.0.25 and asyncpg 0.29.0 runtime parity remains unverified; isolated tests used SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 and asyncpg 0.31.0.
Mapper and technical identity algorithm versions are recorded by Manifest v2 but are not business-table columns.

components.name: Research Skill
components.responsibility: Apply research method and economic reasoning to visible evidence and emit ResearchDecision proposals.
current_limitations: Architecture contract only; no Skill runtime, prompt package, permission identity, or execution integration is implemented.

components.name: Decision Validator
components.responsibility: Validate ResearchDecision schema, permission, state, budget, duplication, evidence visibility, and Frozen Test restrictions before Run creation.
current_limitations: JSON Schema and architecture contract exist; no executable validator, policy store, or permission enforcement is implemented.

components.name: Bounded Code Orchestrator
components.responsibility: Own persistent loop state, permissions, budgets, idempotency, concurrency, Run/Artifact coordination, deterministic dispatch, retries, timeouts, and recovery.
current_limitations: Target responsibilities are accepted but no QuantMind 2.0 runtime implementation exists; V7 BoundedCampaignRunner and BoundedV7SessionOrchestrator are donor evidence, not compliant implementation.

components.name: Data Foundation
components.responsibility: Tushare-only fixed-500 raw/normalized/Feature/Label authority, fixed-100 Qlib consumer view, immutable Store publication, recovery and legacy retirement.
current_limitations: Incremental updates after 2026-06-23, a distributed Artifact Store and LightGBM Feature Snapshot binding are not implemented.
Formal credentials must be supplied at runtime through TUSHARE_TOKEN.

components.name: Factor DSL
components.responsibility: Canonical typed AST, parameter nodes, static admission, canonicalization, hashing, and bounded compilation.
current_limitations: v1 has a closed 18-node catalog and no structure evolution, Registry lifecycle, Agent loop, API, or UI.

components.name: Factor Compute
components.responsibility: Evaluate admitted DSL Factor Instances against validated Dataset Snapshots and atomically materialize immutable Parquet Factor Values.
current_limitations: Offline single-process v1 only; no distributed compute, object storage, Registry, predictive validation, API, or database index.

components.name: Factor Optimization
components.responsibility: Deterministically search declared DSL lookback-window and factor-internal-weight parameters under explicit trial and failure budgets, then order mechanically eligible validation candidates.
current_limitations: v1 is offline, serial, parameter-only deterministic enumeration; no signal threshold, random or Bayesian search, structure evolution, distributed workers, API, database index, Registry promotion, labels, IC, model, portfolio, or backtest evaluation.
Current code is verified in the QM2-P0-005 uncommitted workspace and is not contained in last_verified_commit.

components.name: Factor Validation
components.responsibility: Materialize the audited Label Contract, validate immutable Factor Values on temporal Train and Validation splits, publish immutable candidate selection, and isolate one-time Frozen Test access.
current_limitations: Offline single-process v1 on one deterministic 300-symbol universe; no regime, cost, turnover, correlation, walk-forward, API, database index, authentication service, Registry promotion or official backtest.
The original QM2-P0-006 Implementation Run remains Git-inconsistent; QM2-P0-006F corrects only the evidence record and does not promote any candidate.

components.name: Factor Registry
components.responsibility: Register immutable Factor Instance research lineage, reconcile sibling snapshots, derive governed status, publish content-addressed snapshots, and require explicit promotion decisions.
current_limitations: Offline immutable artifact v1 only; no database, API/UI, actor authorization service, automatic redundancy analysis, LightGBM/Qlib consumption, or active Factor.
The current 20-entry canonical Snapshot has one new research-only Entry and zero promotion candidates, approved Factors, or active Factors.

components.name: Agent Research Campaign
components.responsibility: Accept closed Research Goals, obtain sanitized Agent structure proposals, enforce novelty and budgets, dispatch existing DSL/Optimization, evaluate contaminated Development feedback, and append research-only Registry entries.
current_limitations: Offline single-process artifact runtime only; no API, database index, concurrency worker, model, backtest, or promotion.

QM2-P0-012 remains an immutable partial two-call Campaign. QM2-P0-012F completed one external Codex Campaign through generated parameter guidance, strict Control validation, Store publication, cold recovery and exact replay.
Codex CLI Provider transport uses explicit_values because nested composition and uniqueItems keywords were rejected; the full formal Search Space contract remains enforced by Control.
All 2025 feedback is contaminated adaptive research only and requires fresh formal Validation.

components.name: Fresh Validation
components.responsibility: Lock admitted candidate lineage before future data, track exposure and source watermarks, accrue immutable post-lock data, and perform one fixed-window one-time evaluation after maturity.
current_limitations: Real source ends before the 2026-07-17 lock, so eligible count is zero and no real Fresh result exists.
Control artifacts are durable in Git; future large accrual/result artifacts still need persistent storage.

components.name: Security Termination Policy and Audit
components.responsibility: Represent evidence-backed security termination and settlement events, classify formal Qlib exposure, and gate canonical strategy and benchmark conclusions without inferred settlement.
current_limitations: The governed Tushare graph has no cash, conversion, merger-exchange or write-off settlement evidence for the audited 2025 terminations, so affected Fixed-100 benchmark metrics remain noncanonical.
The existing TopkDropout path exposes executed orders and positions but not formal daily target weights; the audit records target weights as unavailable instead of reconstructing them by assumption.

components.name: Experiment Manager
components.responsibility: Bind Agent, trials, validation, model, signal, backtest, artifacts, data, code, environment, and seed lineage.
current_limitations: Not implemented.

components.name: Unified Signal Service
components.responsibility: Create immutable orientation-, transform-, combination-, missingness-, Dataset- and Universe-aware signals for Qlib.
current_limitations: V1 supports fixed transformations and fixed/equal combinations only; no dynamic weighting, model, optimization, API or UI.
Current real inputs are research_diagnostic and ineligible for production.

components.name: Strategy Layer
components.responsibility: Bind Unified Signal, fixed TopK Dropout strategy, deterministic targets, formal Qlib evidence, canonicality and research-only lifecycle.
current_limitations: No LightGBM integration, risk model, Strategy Validation, Promotion, API or UI.
Existing baseline Qlib source results expose positions but not pre-trade target weights, so baseline target equality is not directly verifiable.

components.name: Strategy Parameter Optimization
components.responsibility: Search only TopK, n_drop and trade-date rebalance interval through deterministic Studies and formal Qlib Trials, then lock research-only candidates using annual CSI300 evidence.
current_limitations: All current evidence is retrospective contaminated research and unusable for Promotion or production.
All four selected candidates are parameter-unstable and underperform CSI300 in both retrospective 2025 and 2026H1 reports.
No Strategy Risk/Validation Gate, API, UI or distributed execution exists.

components.name: Persistent Research Artifact Store
components.responsibility: Persist immutable content-addressed research artifacts, validate domains, inventory reachable evidence and provide verified recovery.
current_limitations: Single-host local filesystem only; no cloud backend, distributed lock, metadata API/UI, automatic synchronization or deletion GC.

components.name: Artifact-backed Research Runtime
components.responsibility: Resolve, verify, materialize, validate, replay and publish formal research artifacts through the immutable Artifact Store without depending on legacy source directories.
current_limitations: Single-process local materialization locks only; no cloud backend, distributed cache/lock, database catalog, API/UI, Qlib or LightGBM cutover.
legacy_local remains an explicit emergency compatibility mode and cannot establish formal publication without Store import.

components.name: Tushare Corporate Action Provider and Settlement
components.responsibility: Capture redacted Tushare capability evidence, normalize immutable security corporate-action events, enforce governed settlement completeness, and gate Fixed-100 benchmark revisions.
current_limitations: The current Tushare account cannot access issuer announcements or structured merger endpoints, and available responses do not provide complete settlement terms for the two governed events.
No benchmark revision is publishable until both normalized events are settlement-complete; affected Fixed-100 metrics remain noncanonical.

components.name: Tushare Expanded-feature Agent Factor Iteration v2
components.responsibility: Recover existing Factor definitions, materialize a PIT-safe Fixed-100 Feature Catalog v2, run bounded external-Agent structure research and factor-only parameter search through four independent walk-forward Folds, and publish research-only immutable Qlib evidence.
current_limitations: Evidence is retrospective adaptive research, not Fresh Validation, Frozen Test, Promotion or production evidence.
The sole eligible Candidate underperforms CSI300 in both retrospective 2025 and 2026H1 despite positive RankIC, so the formal assessment is mixed.
Runtime is single-process/local-Store and does not provide API, UI, distributed execution or LightGBM consumption.

components.name: Momentum Factor Family Iteration v1
components.responsibility: Build a bounded PIT-safe multi-family Momentum Feature Catalog, run external-Agent DSL research with independent four-Fold parameter selection and stability gates, evaluate fixed formal Qlib evidence, and publish research-only immutable artifacts with exact replay.
current_limitations: Evidence is retrospective adaptive research and is not Fresh Validation, Frozen Test, Promotion or production evidence.
Only one family produced a standalone eligible candidate, so the at-least-two-family final-lock gate produced zero locks and no later-period candidate or ensemble report.
Runtime remains single-process/local-Store and has no API, UI, distributed execution or LightGBM consumer.

components.name: Momentum Signal Semantic Audit and Alpha Decomposition v1
components.responsibility: Audit the immutable R1-003 signals and publish deterministic semantic, cross-sectional, beta, style, concentration, contribution, cost, regime, correlation and failure-classification evidence with Store recovery and exact replay.
current_limitations: 2025 and 2026H1 are retrospective reports, not Fresh Validation or predictive evidence.
Market-beta decomposition is diagnostic rather than strict causal attribution; sector concentration is omitted because no PIT industry contract exists.
The decision is research evidence only and does not execute a successor or change Registry state.

components.name: Factor and Strategy Parameter Optimization Overfit Ablation v1
components.responsibility: Recover immutable R1-003 parameter contracts and compare no, local and full factor, strategy and combined optimization through walk-forward formal-Qlib diagnostics without generating or promoting Factors.
current_limitations: This is retrospective contaminated diagnostic evidence, not Fresh Validation, Frozen Test, Promotion or production evidence.
For both frozen candidates the one-parameter direct-neighbor space equals the three-point full factor space, so F1 and F2 cannot reveal a factor search-size effect.
Its historical decision remains immutable; QM2-R1-006 applies that decision only to new research.

components.name: Default-first Optimization Governance v2
components.responsibility: Enforce explicit Agent defaults, default-first Factor and Strategy evaluation, bounded one-hop local rescue, diagnostic-only full search, suspended combined optimization, Candidate metadata and immutable policy evidence for new research.
current_limitations: The policy governs new research only and does not rewrite legacy Optimization Studies, Trials or Candidate Locks.
Local rescue remains research-only until independent new-time evidence is available.
Full search remains available only as explicitly enabled diagnostic evidence and can never select or promote a Candidate.

components.name: Default-first Momentum Structure Search v2
components.responsibility: Run bounded external-Agent momentum structure research with explicit defaults, default-first development evaluation, R1-006 one-hop rescue, immutable parameter locking, annual eligibility and report-only later periods.
current_limitations: The evidence is retrospective research, not Fresh Validation, Frozen Test, Promotion or production evidence.
All eight default structures and thirteen legal local Trials failed the frozen development gate, so no Development Lock, annual locked evaluation, Candidate Lock or report-period result exists.
Runtime is single-process and uses the existing local filesystem Artifact Store.
